create.name: Jeanne Corrigal
create.bio:
Jeanne Corrigal is the guiding teacher of the Saskatoon Insight Meditation Community in Saskatchewan, where she has practised since its first retreat in 1999. She trained first in two of Spirit Rock's lay programmes, for dedicated practitioners and for community dharma leaders, and then in the Insight Meditation Society's four-year teacher training, completed in 2021, after which she was formally empowered to teach. Her lineage runs mainly through the Burmese Mahasi tradition and the Thai forest teachers Ajahn Chah and Ajahn Buddhadasa, and she also took precepts with Thich Nhat Hanh. She is Métis, and the teachings of nature passed on by her family and by the Cree Elder Jim Settee shape how she practises and teaches.

Each Wednesday evening she leads a sitting, talk and discussion in Saskatoon that can also be joined on Zoom, with a loving-kindness practice on the last Wednesday of the month, and the talks are shared as recordings. She also guides daylong retreats in the city, residential retreats on the Prairies, and days that bring Indigenous and Buddhist wisdom together, and she is regularly invited to teach at other insight centres in Canada and the United States, including the Insight Meditation Society.

courses.title: A Simple, Quiet Day: December Daylong
courses.description: An in-person day of meditation in Saskatoon with Jeanne, centred on stillness, rest and kindness ahead of the festive season. It includes instruction, reflections and lying-down practice.

courses.title: Compassion and Resilience in Our Times: January Daylong
courses.description: A daylong retreat in Saskatoon on compassion for others and for oneself, with teaching, practice and a Quan Yin chanting ceremony. Open to beginners and experienced meditators.

courses.title: Indigenous Insight: The Four Elements
courses.description: A silent day, in Saskatoon and on Zoom, exploring earth, water, fire and air in the body and in nature through both Indigenous and Theravada Buddhist teachings. Offered with True North Insight and open to Indigenous and non-Indigenous people.

courses.title: The Wise and Awakened Heart: June Metta Retreat
courses.description: A six-night residential retreat near Edmonton on the four heart qualities of kindness, compassion, joy and equanimity, taught with Adrianne Ross and Rachel Lewis. Includes instructions, talks and practice sessions; commuter places are also offered.

courses.title: Steady, Warm, and Spacious: June Insight Retreat
courses.description: A nine-night residential retreat in St. Albert, Alberta, with Guy and Sally Armstrong, using the breath as a base for concentration, loving-kindness and mindful awareness. Includes talks, instructions and mindful movement.

free_resources.title: Wednesday Night Talks (recordings)
free_resources.description: Recordings of Jeanne's weekly sittings and dharma talks from 2023 onwards, gathered by year on the community's SoundCloud. A good way to sample her teaching before joining live.

free_resources.title: Wednesday Evening Sitting and Talk
free_resources.description: A weekly evening gathering in Saskatoon, also on Zoom, with a half-hour sitting followed by a talk and discussion led by Jeanne. Offered by donation and open to all.
